mapper.sql: id, name, subtitle, category_id, main_image, sub_images, detail, original_price, price, stock, sales, status, is_hot, is_new, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND is_hot = 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM product WHERE status = 1 AND is_new = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, subtitle, category_id, main_image, sub_images, detail, original_price, price, stock, sales, status, is_hot, is_new, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{subtitle}, #{categoryId}, #{mainImage}, #{subImages}, #{detail}, #{originalPrice}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{status}, #{isHot}, #{isNew}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
